name: ai.priorlight/priorlight
title: Priorlight
description: Patent search reports and application drafts, with a free first look. Drafts only, not legal advice.

tools.name: analyze_invention
tools.description: List the invention's key elements, alternatives and open gaps from an intake so the user can confirm them before search or drafting. Needs an API key. Returns drafts only, not legal advice. Results must be reviewed by a registered patent attorney or patent agent.

intake.description: Invention intake (JSON): {offer:"search|draft|bundle", CORE:{problem, solution, how_it_works, alternatives, known_art, advantages, key_elements:[{id:"E1",text,required}], inventors:[], figures:[]}, SEARCH:{keywords:[]}, date_alerts:[], open_gaps:[]}. Full schema: get_intake_schema. Check with validate_intake first.

tools.name: assemble_application
tools.description: Combine finished claims, specification and figure jobs into one patent application draft. Async: returns a job_id; poll get_job. Paid: Patent application draft ($99) or bundle ($149). Returns drafts only, not legal advice. Results must be reviewed by a registered patent attorney or patent agent.

intake.description: Invention intake (JSON): {offer:"search|draft|bundle", CORE:{problem, solution, how_it_works, alternatives, known_art, advantages, key_elements:[{id:"E1",text,required}], inventors:[], figures:[]}, SEARCH:{keywords:[]}, date_alerts:[], open_gaps:[]}. Full schema: get_intake_schema. Check with validate_intake first.

claims_job_id.description: job_id of a finished draft_claims job for the same intake. Example: "8b1c2d3e-...".

specification_job_id.description: job_id of a finished draft_specification job. Example: "8b1c2d3e-...".

figure_job_id.description: job_id of a finished generate_figures job. Example: "8b1c2d3e-...".

idempotency_key.description: Your stable unique key for this request; reuse it to retry safely. Format: any non-empty string. Example: "order-7f3a-claims-1".

sku_id.description: Fixed value for this tool: "assemble_application-v1". The server sets the price.

terms_accepted.description: Set true to accept the Terms, Privacy Policy and Confidentiality and Non-Use Agreement and receive a checkout link. Example: true.

offer.description: Optional offer to buy. Default: the lowest-priced open offer that includes this tool.

job_id.description: job_id returned by an earlier tool call. Example: "8b1c2d3e-...".

tools.name: preview_patentability
tools.description: Free first look for an invention described in plain text: searches official patent office records and returns how many verified related patents turned up, their main classes, the 3 closest with links, and how to order the full search report. No analysis or opinion. Limited to 5 previews per hour per user. Free, no key. Returns drafts only, not legal advice. Results must be reviewed by a registered patent attorney or patent agent.

description.description: Plain-text description of the invention: what it is and how it works, 1-5 sentences. Example: "A phone case with a fold-out stand that also acts as a cooling fan intake."

key_features.description: Optional main features, one short phrase each (max 8). Example: ["fold-out stand","fan intake vent"]

keywords.description: Optional search words or synonyms (max 8). Example: ["phone case","kickstand","cooling"]

tools.name: quick_novelty_screen_lite
tools.description: Return up to 5 verified related patents for a full intake, with no analysis. Needs an API key; without one use preview_patentability. Returns drafts only, not legal advice. Results must be reviewed by a registered patent attorney or patent agent.
